identity.rationale: Logical attempt identity names the semantic benchmark attempt. Runtime and authority identity are independently bound by the durable start CAS.

single_source_chain.producer: authorized prestart guard after exact digest-pinned task identity is known
consumers: prestart planner request identity and seed
planner request identity for every cycle

seed_effect.statement: Changing logical attempt identity changes deterministic planner seed but not the seed domain.
seed_effect.bound: seed = int(request_identity_sha256[:8],16) & 0x7fffffff, therefore decimal serialization is at most 10 digits
seed_effect.requirement: Production exact token counting remains authoritative on every planner call; any static all-cycle proof should explicitly include seed-width variance.
